home.title: Sahel AgriConnect
home.subtitle: Digitalization of agriculture across West Africa and beyond
home.projectDescription: The Sahel Agricultural Transformation Project (PTASS) aims to digitalize and modernize agriculture across West Africa and beyond to achieve food sovereignty and enhance local production.

foodSovereignty.title: Food Sovereignty
foodSovereignty.description: Ensure food autonomy for populations across West Africa and beyond through modern and sustainable agriculture.

valorization.title: Valorization
valorization.description: Maximize the value of local agricultural production and improve incomes for farmers and cooperatives.

period.description: Five-year roadmap to sustainably transform agriculture in West Africa and beyond.

priorityCereals.description: Essential local production for food security

standard.title: Standard Quality
standard.description: Production meeting basic standards for local consumption and regional markets.

premium.title: Premium Quality
premium.description: High-quality production for urban markets and regional export with certification.

excellence.title: Excellence Quality
excellence.description: Certified excellence production for international export with complete traceability.

irrigation.title: Irrigation
irrigation.description: Development of modern and sustainable irrigation systems to improve agricultural productivity and reduce dependence on seasonal rainfall.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: Optimization of logistics chains to facilitate transport of agricultural products from production areas to local and international markets.

growthPotential.title: Growth Potential
growthPotential.description: West Africa and beyond have immense untapped agricultural potential. With the right technologies, infrastructure and training, agricultural production can be multiplied by 3 to 5 times, creating major economic opportunities for farmers and communities.

cta.title: Join the PTASS Project
cta.description: Whether you are a farmer, cooperative, investor or partner, participate in the transformation of agriculture across West Africa and beyond.

afriYield.sheaBody: West African shea butter is one of the most sought-after natural fats globally, used in cosmetics, food manufacturing, and pharmaceuticals. AfriYield Exchange connects investors directly to certified shea cooperatives and transformation centers.
afriYield.sheaStats: Key stats: Global market size $2.7B+, Primary buyers: EU, USA, Japan, Certification: USDA/EU Organic available
afriYield.sesameBody: African sesame is prized for its high oil content and clean flavor profile. Major importers include Japan, China, and the EU. AfriYield Exchange provides a certified, traceable supply chain from West African producers to global buyers.
afriYield.sesameStats: Key stats: Global market size $7B+, Primary buyers: Japan, China, EU, Certification: USDA/EU standards available
afriYield.whyVerifiedBody: Every transformation center and cooperative is registered and verified through Sahel AgriConnect before appearing on AfriYield Exchange
afriYield.whyReturnsBody: Bi-annual ROI payouts with transparent reporting. Track A is asset-backed. Track B is revenue-share.
afriYield.whyReachBody: Producers from across West Africa and beyond. One platform, one investment process, continental scale.
afriYield.quote1: Investing in Track A gave me direct connection to the shea supply chain I'd been looking for. The verification process gave me confidence.
afriYield.quote2: AfriYield Exchange is the bridge I needed between my capital and African agriculture. Simple, transparent, impactful.
afriYield.quote3: As a second-generation Malian in the US, this platform lets me invest in the communities my family came from.
